name: Photon energy
meaning: Energy of one photon (J or eV) from its frequency f (Hz) or wavelength λ (m); h = 6.626×10⁻³⁴ J·s.

name: Photon energy shortcut
meaning: Quick photon energy in electron volts from wavelength in nanometers, since hc = 1240 eV·nm.

name: Einstein's photoelectric equation
meaning: Maximum kinetic energy (eV) of electrons ejected by photons of energy hf from a surface with work function φ. No emission if hf is less than φ.

name: Threshold frequency and wavelength
meaning: Lowest frequency (longest wavelength) of light that can eject electrons from a material with work function φ.

name: Stopping voltage
meaning: The reverse voltage Vₛ (V) that stops the fastest photoelectrons measures their kinetic energy; in eV the number equals Vₛ in volts.

name: Photon rate from power
meaning: Number of photons per second in a beam of power P (W) at frequency f or wavelength λ.

name: Photon momentum
meaning: Momentum (kg·m/s) carried by one photon of wavelength λ or energy E.

name: Radiation force on an absorber
meaning: Force (N) exerted by a light beam of power P (W) that is completely absorbed.
